entity: Hungarian ATM mandate — Act XVIII of 2025 (ATMtv.), NGM decree 16/2025 (V. 29.), MNB decree 19/2025 (VI. 26.)
signal: [STANDING — dated 2025, RE-VERIFIED LINE BY LINE AGAINST THE PRIMARY DECREE TEXTS ON 27/08/2026]. Both decrees remain in force UNAMENDED (consolidated-text stamps re-read this run: NGM 16/2025 'Hatály: 2025.VI.6. -'; MNB 19/2025 'Hatály: 2025.VI.27. -'; no 2026 amendment). NGM 16/2025 §1 sets the two phases on 2022 KSH census data: (a) from 31/12/2025 in every settlement with more than 1,000 inhabitants, (b) from 31/12/2026 in every settlement with more than 500 inhabitants. MNB 19/2025 Annex 1 ('A pénzforgalmi szolgáltatók telepítéssel érintett településenkénti meghatározása' — the determination, settlement by settlement, of which payment service provider is obliged) lists 1,039 named settlements grouped into 80 SETTLEMENT PACKAGES (településcsomag), each package assigned to ONE obligated payment service provider. Package split re-counted directly from Annex 1 this run and reproduced exactly: OTP Bank Nyrt. 33, MBH Bank Nyrt. 15, K&H Bank Zrt. 9, ERSTE BANK HUNGARY Zrt. 8, Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. 5, CIB Bank Zrt. 4, UniCredit Bank Hungary Zrt. 4, GRÁNIT Bank Nyrt. 1, MagNet Bank Zrt. 1 — nine institutions, 80 packages, 1,039 settlements. THE DECREE PUBLISHES NO PER-BANK ATM COUNT: Annex 1 has only three columns (package number, settlement name, obligated provider), so the per-bank ATM numbers struck from the 01/08 file are still NOT restated — no such column exists. ALLOCATION FORMULA (MNB 19/2025 §1(1)(a), added this run): the burden is split on 2024 data weighted 20% payment-service fee income, 30% number of issued debit cards with a cash-withdrawal function at 31/12/2024, 10% number of consumer payment accounts, 15% number of non-zero-balance retail HUF sight deposits, 25% balance-sheet total, group-level for banking groups; §1(1)(b) then weights each affected settlement by district gross average earnings, population, unemployment rate and share of residents working elsewhere. §3(2)-(3) let providers swap packages or individual settlements and take over each other's obligations by contract (a hand-over of OPERATION cannot be contracted for less than 5 years), with contract deadlines 20/07/2025 for phase (a) and 28/02/2026 for phase (b), notified to MNB through the ERA system by 31/07/2025 and 16/03/2026 respectively; §4(3) requires MNB to review the allocation at least every three years; §4(4) obliges an incoming operator to reimburse the previous operator's documented ATM-installation costs incurred within 3 years. NGM 16/2025 §2 requires the municipality to provide a site that is easily reachable and traffic-frequented, barrier-free, properly lit, has power and internet, and where the ATM can be safely installed, serviced and cash-loaded. OTP Bank, joined by Erste Bank Hungary and Raiffeisen Bank, filed a constitutional complaint with the Alkotmánybíróság (Constitutional Court) on 10/11/2025 arguing the mandate is economically unjustified and disproportionately restricts their property and business rights; NO decision found as of 27/08/2026 — status remains unverified.
